name: Empty cart
description: Shown only while the cart is empty, with a way back to the menu.
source:
Component(
  dsl: 1, id: "market/empty-cart", name: "Empty cart", kind: Kind.section,
  description: "Shown only while the cart is empty, with a way back to the menu.",
  variants: [Variant(id: "default", label: "Default", build:
    If(condition: cart.count == 0, then: Box(padding: Space.xl, radius: Radius.lg, background: Color.surfaceAlt, child: Column(gap: Space.sm, align: Align.center, children: [
      Icon(name: Icons.cart, size: Size.lg, color: Color.textMuted),
      Text(child: "Your cart is empty", size: FontSize.lg, weight: FontWeight.bold),
      Button(label: "Browse the menu", onTap: Navigate(to: Route.menu))
    ])))
  )], data: [Data(name: "cart", from: Client.cart(), fetch: "client", type: Cart)],
)
